problem.title: The vicious cycle of the modern farmer
problem.subtitle: The more you fertilise synthetically, the more dependent you become. Soils lose their microbial life, plants weaken and your costs keep rising. There's another way.

items.title: Costs that keep rising
items.desc: Fertilisers, pesticides, tillage… more expensive every year, with shrinking margins.

items.title: Increasingly inert soils
items.desc: Intensive mechanisation and herbicides destroy the microbial fauna that makes the land fertile.

items.title: Dependence on external inputs
items.desc: Every season relying on suppliers, global prices and supply chains you don't control.

items.title: Uncertainty in the face of climate
items.desc: Droughts, resistant pests, irregular seasons… without soil resilience, every event becomes a crisis.

problem.quote: Fertility cannot be bought. It must be cultivated, understood and returned to the soil.
problem.quoteAuthor: Carles Pons — Founder of Bosque Madre

ecosystem.title: How we work with you
ecosystem.intro: Every advisory process starts by understanding your reality before proposing solutions. We don't apply one-size-fits-all recipes: we adapt the process to the type of farm, the stage of the project and the level of support you need.

items.title: First orientation
items.desc: An initial conversation to understand your situation, your goals and the kind of help you need. From there we assess whether a one-off consultation, a deeper diagnosis or ongoing support makes more sense.

items.title: Diagnosis and system reading
items.desc: We analyse the information available: farm characteristics, current management, crops, soil, water, inputs, photos, lab tests or, when necessary, an on-site visit. The goal is to properly understand the system before intervening.

items.title: Personalised roadmap
items.desc: We define a clear, actionable proposal: priorities, action protocol, timeline and next steps. Depending on the case, we can support you through implementation, review progress and adjust the plan along the way.

seo.title: The Programme — Suelos Vivos
seo.description: Three in-person workshops plus 10 months of biofertility and regenerative agriculture coaching. 2026–2027 programme in Tormos, Alicante. Only 20 places.

hero.title:
Three workshops.
Ten months.
A different soil.
hero.subtitle: Suelos Vivos is an annual training programme designed for professional farmers who want to understand the biology of their soil and apply biofertility techniques on their own farm.

items.label: In-person workshops
items.desc: Full weekends in Tormos (Alicante). Theory + real field practice with materials included.

items.label: Months of coaching
items.desc: Monthly online sessions between workshops. Questions answered, plan adjusted, personalised follow-up.

items.label: Places per edition
items.desc: Small groups to ensure personalised attention and peer learning. No waiting list.

items.title: Living soil: diagnosis and foundations
items.desc: The first workshop lays the groundwork. You will learn to understand the soil as a living ecosystem, identify its health indicators and diagnose the state of your farm before intervening.
topics: Soil biology: fungi, bacteria, soil fauna and their roles
How to read a soil analysis (and what it doesn't tell you)
Visual and sensory indicators of soil health
Practical field diagnosis: your soil has a history

items.title: Biofertility in practice
items.desc: The second workshop is the most hands-on. Together we will produce the main bioinputs: inoculants, broths and activated compost. All using accessible materials reproducible on your farm.
topics: Foliar and soil biofertilisation: when and how
Techniques for capturing and multiplying local microorganisms
Protocols adapted to different crops and climates

items.title: Autonomy and plan design
items.desc: The third workshop closes the cycle. You will design your own biofertility plan for the next 3 years, evaluate the first year's results and map the route to technical autonomy.
topics: Evaluating results: how to measure soil improvement
Designing rotations and regenerative cover crops
Personalised biofertility plan for your farm
Long-term water and organic matter management
Cost calculation and real economic impact
Roadmap: the next 3 years on your farm

items.title: Monthly online sessions
items.desc: One hour each month to review progress, resolve technical questions and adjust the plan to what is happening on your farm.

items.title: Private participant group
items.desc: A direct channel between all participants. To share results, experiences and mutual support among farmers.

items.title: Resource library
items.desc: Protocols, technical sheets, videos and selected bibliography. Fully accessible during and after the programme.

seo.title: About Us — Suelos Vivos
seo.description: Suelos Vivos is the training programme of Bosque Madre, a regenerative agriculture project with over 15 years of real experience in the Mediterranean.

hero.title:
Born from the field.
Not the office.
hero.subtitle: Bosque Madre is a regenerative agriculture project with over 15 years of real practice in the Mediterranean. Suelos Vivos is our way of sharing what we have learned.

story.title: Over 15 years transforming soils in the Mediterranean
paragraphs: Bosque Madre was born from a simple question: is it possible to produce quality food, reduce costs and improve the soil at the same time?

The answer, after years of experimentation on our farm in Tormos (Alicante), is yes. But it requires changing the way we understand soil: not as an inert support to which nutrients are added, but as a living ecosystem that, when it works well, fertilises, protects and sustains the crop.

We have been practising, documenting and teaching these techniques for over 15 years. What started as a personal search became a reference point for the regenerative movement in Spain and southern Europe.
Suelos Vivos is the distillation of all that learning: a programme designed so that professional farmers can follow the same path with real support.

items.title: Practice over theory
items.desc: Everything we teach we have done with our own hands. We don't lecture about what's in books; we share what works in the field.

items.title: Autonomy as the goal
items.desc: The goal is not for you to depend on us. It's for you to finish the programme with the tools, knowledge and confidence to continue on your own.

items.title: The soil as teacher
items.desc: Observe, listen and read the soil before intervening. Nature has been solving problems for millions of years; our job is to understand it.

location.title: Tormos, Alicante. The classroom is the field.
location.desc1: The Bosque Madre farm in Tormos, in the interior of Alicante, is where the in-person workshops take place. A real Mediterranean environment: dry climate, calcareous soils and crops such as olive, carob, citrus and market garden.
location.desc2: This is not an experimental space created for the programme. It is an active agricultural holding where every technique is applied with real consequences. That makes the learning different.

seo.title: Professional Advisory — Suelos Vivos
seo.description: Personalised regenerative agriculture consulting: regeneration protocols, input reduction plans, farm design, biological waste management and biofactory installation.

hero.title: Do you have a project and want us to support you?
hero.subtitleP1: Suelos Vivos helps farmers, farms and agroecological projects make better decisions about their soil, its fertility and their regenerative transition.
hero.subtitleP2: We bring technical judgement, an ecological outlook and hands-on support to turn complex problems into a roadmap that is clear, workable and tailored to each reality.

items.title: Soil regeneration protocol
items.desc: Detailed diagnosis of the biological, physical and chemical state of your farm, followed by a personalised roadmap to progressively and sustainably restore microbial life and fertility.

items.title: Input reduction plan
items.desc: Analysis of your current cost structure and design of a progressive strategy to reduce synthetic fertilisers, pesticides and tillage without compromising crop yields.

items.title: Integral farm design
items.desc: Full agroecological planning of your operation: crop rotations, cover crops, water management, hedgerows and ecological corridors, and production diversification.

items.title: Biological waste management
items.desc: Design of protocols to transform organic waste from your farm — stubble, slurry, pruning residues, plant matter — into high-value biological amendments that return fertility to the soil.

items.title: Biofactory installation
items.desc: On-site design and installation of self-production systems for bioinputs: microbial inoculants, activated compost and mineral broths so your farm generates its own biological fertilisers.
